about: Evidence recommendations for the UAE Information Assurance Standard v2.1 library (uae_ia.json). Authored for this library: the standard itself names no evidence. Every item is grounded in the control's own statement, sub-controls or implementation guidance, and 'covers' lists the numbered sub-controls (1), 2) ...) it helps to evidence; every sub-control of every control is covered by at least one item (an empty 'covers' marks evidence of the control statement itself, such as an approval or an inspection). build_uae_ia_catalog.py merges this file into the generated catalog as evidence_requirements {name, description, filetype} and drops 'covers'; the other keys (collection_frequency where the control is event-driven or continuous, is_mandatory, type, retention_period, ai_confidence, ai_reasoning) go on as they are, a null included, because the seeder reads them from dict entries and otherwise defaults to annually, required, 3 years, 85% and 'Generated from framework seeding'.
